campaign.source: Preserved research/proposal: SOURCE-PLAN-2026-09-20.md, copied with whitespace normalized from research/codkit-universal-fork-review-2026-09-20/03-synthesis-and-plan.md. Product contracts govern implementation; the source's architectural recommendations do not silently resolve its owner decision list.

baseline.fact: Worktree was created from 03d2cee and rebased to a9a11c7; main, origin/main and github/main agree on a9a11c7. Main is clean.

Initial machine-readable public-format catalogs: 0. Initial public-format compatibility gates: 0. Candidate: 1 catalog with 55 entries, 1 gate and 10 focused tests. Of 55 entries, 11 have explicit inherited-version or missing-version gaps.
The initial P0.1 inventory atom changed no production TypeScript, runtime output, consumer serializers or history fingerprints. Later contract atoms below intentionally add opt-in format transitions.

decisions.decision: Start with the P0.1 inventory. It exposes compatibility gaps without choosing config v3, trusted registry locations or organization licence semantics. Deferring all development until those decisions would lose the independently useful discovery/gate step.

Keep runtime validators and governing contracts authoritative. Catalog metadata records current behavior; assigning invented versions or automatically rewriting consumers is rejected. Revisit when implementing the source plan's migration atoms.

Use the installed TypeScript 7 scanner for a bounded static coverage tripwire; do not execute adapters. Its removed legacy compiler API prevents the old parser path. Dynamic/computed format conventions require explicit catalog/discovery fixtures; this gate is not a proof of arbitrary program behavior.

predictions.prediction: Existing consumer serialization and generated history remain byte-identical: this atom edits tooling, metadata and the npm development gate only.
Deleting a format policy, changing a numeric schema or deleting migration/test evidence makes the focused gate red.
The complete floor is already blocked on the base; catalog changes alone cannot make it green.

route.phase: Read the source proposal, inspect schemas and probe baseline gates; no commits. Complete.

Public-contract hardening: P0.1-P0.5 and P0.9 are implemented candidates. P0.7 is next; the delegated technical decisions and remaining owner boundaries are recorded below. Exit: exact existing fixture compatibility and complete project floor.
Licensing and release evidence: P0.10 and the evidence portion of P0.7. Expand after organization-policy decisions.
Local workspace lifecycle: P0.11; workspace pairs, unique refs and writer refusal.
Trusted external type supply: P0.3/P0.4 with a real partner; offline install, integrity and pre-import handshake proof.
Measured expansion with real consumers: codec seam P0.6, coordinator contract P0.8, build recipe design P0.12; new implementation follows its polygon.

current-atom.perimeter: Component release descriptor contract, library construction and immutable persistence, package/publish integration, public-format catalog, operational docs and focused release evidence tests.
current-atom.acceptance: Each successful single-component package/publish yields an immutable descriptor with component identity, revision/provenance, patchset commit, type declaration/contract, discipline, generated tip, artifact hashes, recipe identity, licence-policy digest and distribution evidence references. Unknown or unverified evidence must remain explicit. Finish with the complete native project floor.
current-atom.negative-proof: Reject altered/foreign descriptors, conflicting immutable writes, escaping artifact paths and false evidence claims. Prove deterministic retries and preserve existing publish leases, tag immutability and package restore behavior.
current-atom.safe-stop: P0.9 is committed as 49f41d2 with complete runtime validation. P0.7 schema and immutable storage foundation is implemented; package/publish fact capture and integration remain open; legal rulings, signing custody and the real external partner remain outside the delegated technical defaults.

campaign.quick-start: git status --short git log --oneline -3 npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund npm run formats:check npm run typecheck npm run runtime:check npm run trace:check npm run docs:check npm run floor
campaign.whole-campaign-acceptance: Each later phase supplies its source-plan polygon and a green complete floor. This first atom does not establish type ABI, trusted external supply, licence evidence, discipline, workspaces or multi-component release acceptance.

review-points.open: The owner delegated unattended development on 2026-10-03. Reversible technical defaults follow the source proposal and are recorded in product contracts; commercial legal rulings, signing custody and a real external-type partner remain external boundaries. The source decision inventory is the eight numbered items in the source plan's “Решения владельца перед кодированием”: Git boundary, discipline axis, schema migration, component/coordinator split, registry/policy trust, runtime inclusion, commercial notice ruling, signing and type namespace ownership. Inventory work does not ratify them.

execution-ledger.entry: P0.7 foundation 74b726b: strict root-versioned component descriptor codec, semantic digest/commit/tree brands, deterministic sorting and SHA-256 sealing, typed failure results, and contained exclusive immutable storage. Seven focused tests prove canonical retries, changed-body digest refusal, future/noncanonical data refusal, evidence status/missing consistency including empty requirements, duplicate/path refusals, conflicting bytes preservation, parent substitution refusal and filename/body binding. Typecheck, 58-format catalog with 10 negative coverage tests, 263-file runtime and trace, docs and native conform (eight frozen/zero new) pass. This is not Phase 1 acceptance: package/publish does not yet emit the descriptor and real distribution evidence remains P0.10. Read-only discovery found existing nimbus consumer; external supplier/consumer and approved legal/signing references are requested asynchronously, with independent development continuing.

P0.9 implemented in 49f41d2: explicit config v4 accepts a missing human tag; operational keys use the full SHA and literal tag stamps stay empty. v2/v3 ordinary config bytes and tagged names remain unchanged. New resolutions record resolvedAt; optional provenance is declaration data, not authenticated evidence. Cycle state 3 and stabilization report 2 carry new evidence without widening old formats. CLI hard-crash recovery proves both tag and SHA paths through completion even after deleting the original Git tag. The final offline non-root Linux snapshot passes 208 test files, 2727 tests (one file/four existing conditional cases skipped), all format/receipt/typecheck/runtime/trace/docs/supply checks and the installed native structural floor with eight frozen findings and zero new. A final type-only restoration of PinConfig readonly fields passes current typecheck and the 262-file runtime comparison. Negative journal tests reject new pin evidence in old state/report versions. Supporting fixture correction: product tests distinguish a literal human tag from a derived SHA branch key.

Process disappearance race fixed in d9b1041: ENOENT/ESRCH mean gone, while EACCES/EPERM remain fail closed. All four focused cases and the 18-case crash/resume matrix pass in the final offline non-root Linux snapshot. Formatting, public formats, installed receipts, typecheck, runtime, trace, docs, supply checks, the complete Vitest suite and native structural floor pass. Structural conform retains eight frozen findings with zero new; specmap is clean with its existing zero-code extraction warning. The npm Vibe launcher compatibility issue is bypassed through the installed in-place native engine, not by disabling additional checks.

P0.5 candidate adds config v3 with explicit minimal-intervention@1, read-only-by-default config migrate and a lock/cross-operation/CAS guarded --write. Legacy v2 retains ordinary config/inventory/fingerprint bytes; explicit v3 binds the profile into delta/history fingerprint and verification evidence. Focused compatibility and CLI checks pass. The complete Linux suite passes all 206 test files (four platform/optional cases remain skipped by their existing conditions).

Structural cleanup: package routing/process seams moved in 0a5844d; declaration fixture formatting 0dd7d63. Config diagnostics moved behind their own seam. A native in-place conform check now has 8 frozen findings and zero new findings without changing the baseline. Native specmap regenerated 31 added units; code trace remains the non-vacuous scope gate (specmap still reports its existing zero-code extraction limitation).

P0.3 candidate pins three installed type packages and 98 npm-packed file receipts; changed code, declaration bytes and unapproved runtime additions refuse before the first adapter instruction. Focused type tests 39/39 and direct import integrity tests 9/9 pass. A fresh offline package installation matches all approvals. Supporting fixes: conformance executable mode 1d80f59; npm pairing confined to declared targets 745dfd9; injected Windows lookups use win32 paths on every host f70da4e.

Initial offline Linux snapshot ran 2709 tests: 2623 passed, 64 failed, 22 skipped. Failures included old Git 2.39 lacking check-attr --source, root bypassing permission fixtures, absent committer identity, lost executable archive modes, two genuine host-path oracle failures and Theia incorrectly receiving npm pairing. A corrected non-root harness with Git 2.52.0, Git LFS 3.7.1, Git-index modes and isolated npm cache is rerunning; no failing test is suppressed.

Unattended continuation: portable format gate f627bd4 and focused conventions evidence ac01890. Type handshake adds strict declarative data, pre-import compatibility refusal, metadata-only types inspection and a standalone conformance command; all official types pass it. Focused type tests 30/30, catalog tests 10/10, supply kit tests 2/2 and typecheck/runtime/docs/trace/format gates pass. The five-package kit installs into a fresh offline directory from an isolated prefilled cache and reproduces all three registry rows exactly. Manifest digest is not represented as adapter integrity; P0.3 remains open.

Main overlay work committed as a9a11c7 and pushed fast-forward to origin and github. Feature-proof work was stashed including untracked files, rebased without conflicts and restored; dependencies refreshed through npm ci.

Catalog/checker candidate: 55 rows; 10/10 focused tests pass, including negative proofs. Typecheck, 251-file runtime comparison, docs, trace and explicit-glob formatting pass. Product code changes: zero.

Baseline floor: Windows bare Prettier globs match no files. Structural dispatch refuses vibe.lock schema 6 because installed Vibe expects 7. Main overlay symlink fixtures fail EPERM; a Git-backed test exceeded 30 seconds; the complete suite and prolonged E2E save probe were interrupted and are not passes. New npm-prune suite passes 6/6, overlay schema/operation subset 16/16, new JSONC scenario passes.

deferrals.item: Restore a runnable full baseline floor: Windows formatting invocation, compatible Vibe dispatch, symlink privileges and slow Git fixture execution. Preserve existing checks; do not suppress failures.
Dedicated conventions, supply-kit and fresh offline installation proofs have been completed and their former catalog test gaps closed; retain the execution-ledger evidence.

Delegated reversible technical defaults are recorded in product contracts. Obtain the real external partner and resolve commercial legal rulings, signing custody and type namespace ownership before their dependent external-supply/licensing acceptance.
